name: io.github.yuli3/oiyo-calculations
title: OIYO Korea Calculators
description: Korean tax, payroll, labor, real estate, calendar and business strategy calculators. Code, no LLM.

tools.name: find_oiyo_tools
tools.description: Start here when you are not sure which OIYO tool fits. Give the user's question in their own words (Korean or English). Returns the best-matching OIYO tools with their input fields, the terms that matched, and an answerability verdict: 'likely', 'partial' (some parts of the question have no tool) or 'none' (OIYO has no tool for it, so do not invent a number). Searches tool names and descriptions only; no calculation.

question.description: The user's question, e.g. '퇴직금이랑 실업급여 얼마나 받을 수 있어요?'

tools.name: get_kr_minimum_wage
tools.description: Verified Korean minimum wage by year, effective dates and 8/209-hour examples. Not a 2027 net-salary calculator; uncollected insurance is unavailable.

year.description: Korean applicable year; omission uses Asia/Seoul current year

tools.name: get_kr_holidays
tools.description: Get official South Korea public holidays, substitute holidays, and solar terms for a given year.

tools.name: check_kr_business_day
tools.description: Determines if a given date is a South Korea working business day or a public holiday/weekend.

tools.name: calculate_saju_astrology
tools.description: Computes traditional Korean Sexagenary Cycle (60 Gapja) Four Pillars and Five Elements (오행) balance from birth datetime and solar/lunar calendar.

tools.name: calculate_unemployment_benefits
tools.description: Simulates statutory South Korean unemployment benefits (실업급여) duration, daily benefit rate, and total expected payout.

wage.description: Pre-tax average monthly wage before dismissal in KRW

age.description: Whether age is under 50 ('under') or 50 and older / disabled ('over')

tools.name: calculate_weekly_allowance
tools.description: Calculates statutory South Korean weekly holiday allowance (주휴수당) for part-time and hourly workers.

hourlyWage.description: Hourly wage in KRW (2026 minimum wage: 10,320 KRW)

hours.description: Contractual working hours per week (must be >= 15 for allowance)

employedWholeWeek.description: Explicitly confirm employment through the entire applicable week

completedScheduledDays.description: Explicitly confirm attendance on all scheduled working days

tools.name: calculate_overtime_pay
tools.description: Calculates statutory overtime, night, and holiday allowances under Korean Labor Standards Act.

hourlyWage.description: Base ordinary hourly wage in KRW

tools.name: calculate_net_salary
tools.description: Calculates net monthly take-home salary after the 4 major social insurances (2026 statutory rates) and an ESTIMATED income tax (annualized estimate, not the NTS withholding table) in South Korea.

salary.description: Gross monthly or annual salary in KRW

isAnnual.description: True if salary parameter is annual base pay

nonTaxable.description: Monthly non-taxable amount (meal subsidy etc., default 200,000 KRW)

tools.name: calculate_severance_pay
tools.description: South Korean statutory severance arithmetic. Unknown or mixed four-week hours return null eligibility and amount; all-period self-confirmation is required for an estimate.

weeklyHoursCondition.description: Whole service period four-week contractual hours, not hours in the last week

threeMonthSalary.description: Total gross base salary received during last 3 months in KRW

annualBonus.description: Annual bonus paid during previous year in KRW

annualLeaveAllowance.description: Annual unused leave cash-out allowance in KRW

tools.name: calculate_annual_leave
tools.description: Calculates statutory annual paid leave days (연차 휴가) and unused leave cash-out allowance by years of service.

yearsOfService.description: Continuous service duration in completed years

hourlyWage.description: Base ordinary hourly wage in KRW

unusedDays.description: Number of unused leave days to cash out

tools.name: calculate_military_service
tools.description: Calculates South Korea mandatory military service duration, completion rate, remaining days, and rank promotion dates.

tools.name: calculate_gas_bill
tools.description: Calculates South Korea residential city gas invoice amount based on cubic meters used and heating/cooking tariff.

usageM3.description: Gas meter volume in cubic meters (m³)

calorific.description: Optional regional average calorific value in MJ/m³ (default 42.8)

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Universal deterministic unit conversion for area (pyeong ↔ m², sqft, ha), length, mass, and temperature.

tools.name: calculate_cagr
tools.description: Calculates Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR, 연평균 복합 성장률), total ROI, and Rule of 72 milestone.

initialValue.description: Initial investment or starting asset amount

finalValue.description: Final asset value or future valuation

years.description: Investment or operational time horizon in years

tools.name: calculate_compound_interest
tools.description: Simulates compound interest growth with initial principal, annual yield, recurring monthly contributions, and annual balance trajectory.

principal.description: Initial lump sum principal investment amount in KRW or local currency

rate.description: Annual return / interest rate in percent (e.g. 7 for 7%)

monthlyContribution.description: Optional monthly recurring savings or investment amount

tools.name: calculate_health_insurance
tools.description: Calculates Korean regional insurance premiums and preliminary income/property flags only. dependentEligibility.isEligible is null: family support, spouse/sibling conditions, housing rental income and statutory exceptions require NHIS review.

otherIncome.description: Other annual income (근로/연금 등) in KRW

propertyTaxBase.description: Property tax base (재산세 과세표준) in KRW

hasBusinessRegistration.description: Whether registered as a business owner

relationship.description: Candidate's relationship to the employee (default unknown)

isMarried.description: Candidate is married (both spouses must meet the income test)

spouseMeetsIncomeCriteria.description: For a married candidate: spouse also meets the income test

siblingUnmarried.description: Sibling is unmarried (divorced/widowed counts as unmarried)

isDisabledOrMerit.description: Registered disabled person, national merit or veteran-compensation wounded (business income up to 5M allowed regardless of registration)

hasHousingRentalIncome.description: Business income includes housing rental income (treated as registered even without registration)

tools.name: diagnose_hug_guarantee
tools.description: Diagnoses HUG Jeonse Deposit Return Guarantee eligibility (126% rule, 60% senior debt limit, 90% debt ratio limit) and calculates statutory guarantee fee.

officialPrice.description: Publicly declared housing price (공시가격) in KRW

seniorDebt.description: Senior lien / mortgage amount (선순위 채권액) in KRW

tools.name: calculate_capital_gains_tax
tools.description: Calculates South Korea Real Estate Capital Gains Tax with 1-home 1.2 billion KRW exemption, high-value house apportionment, and up to 80% special long-term holding deduction.

expenses.description: Necessary capital expenses (brokerage, remodel, acquisition tax) in KRW

tools.name: compare_vat_tax
tools.description: Compares South Korea Value-Added Tax (VAT) between General Taxpayer (10% with full deduction/refund) and Simplified Taxpayer (15-40% value-added rate, 48M exemption, no refund).

revenue.description: Annual gross revenue (공급대가, VAT-inclusive) in KRW

purchase.description: Annual gross purchases with tax invoices in KRW

tools.name: calculate_inheritance_gift_tax
tools.description: Calculates South Korea 2026 statutory inheritance and gift tax, progressive tax brackets (10-50%), relationship deductions, and voluntary filing discount.

assetValue.description: Gross market value of assets in KRW

debtValue.description: Liabilities or debts assumed in KRW

marriageBirthDeduction.description: Gift from lineal ascendant only: marriage/birth deduction to apply in KRW (lifetime max 100,000,000)

hasSpouse.description: Whether surviving spouse exists (inheritance mode only)

spouseDeduction.description: Inheritance mode: spouse deduction in KRW, clamped to 500,000,000-3,000,000,000 (default 500,000,000)

isGenerationSkipping.description: Generation skipping surcharge (30%; 40% when a minor receives over 2,000,000,000 KRW)

isMinorRecipient.description: Recipient is a minor (defaults to relationship child_minor)

tools.name: calculate_loan_refinance
tools.description: Calculates loan refinancing savings, prepayment penalty fees with 3-year sliding taper, and break-even point in months.

currentRate.description: Existing loan annual interest rate in %

newRate.description: New loan annual interest rate in %

penaltyRate.description: Prepayment penalty rate in % from the loan contract (example default 1.2; actual rates vary by product)

tools.name: calculate_card_tax_deduction
tools.description: Calculates South Korea 2026 year-end card tax deduction, 25% threshold, credit (15%) vs check (30%) rates, and golden ratio strategy.

annualSalary.description: Gross annual salary (비과세 제외) in KRW

creditCardSpend.description: Annual credit card spending in KRW

checkCardSpend.description: Annual check/debit card and cash receipt spending in KRW

cultureSpend.description: Book, performing arts, museum spending in KRW

children.description: Number of child/grandchild dependents (2026 base limit rises by child count, 2+ capped)

tools.name: calculate_kr_year_end_settlement
tools.description: South Korea 2026 귀속 year-end tax settlement (연말정산) for a resident wage earner: income deductions, card deduction, special deductions/credits vs the 130,000 KRW standard credit (picks the lower tax), refund or extra payment when withheld tax is given. Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Refuses unknown inputs and tax years other than 2026; returns statute basis and what is not covered. Estimate, not tax advice.

salary.description: Gross annual salary excluding non-taxable pay (총급여) in KRW

persons.description: Basic deduction persons including self (기본공제 인원, default 1)

otherIncome.description: Other comprehensive income amount (사업·연금·기타소득금액) in KRW; turns this into a May filing approximation

disabledPersons.description: Disabled dependents including self (장애인 추가공제 인원)

nationalPension.description: National pension contributions paid by the employee in KRW

healthEmployment.description: Health, long-term care and employment insurance paid by the employee in KRW

debitCardSpend.description: Debit card and cash receipt spending in KRW

cultureSpend.description: Books, performances, museums, movies, sports facilities in KRW

cardChildren.description: Children counted for the raised card deduction limit

creditChildren.description: Children eligible for the child tax credit (자녀세액공제)

birthOrder.description: Birth/adoption this year: 1 for first child, 2 second, 3 third or later; 0 none

leaseLoanRepaid.description: Jeonse loan principal and interest repaid (주택임차차입금) in KRW

housingSubscriptionPaid.description: Housing subscription savings paid (주택청약종합저축) in KRW

insurancePremium.description: Protection-type insurance premiums (보장성 보험료) in KRW

medical.description: Medical expenses for general dependents in KRW (7M cap)

medicalSpecific.description: Medical expenses for self, 65+, disabled, or children 6 or under in KRW (no cap)

education.description: Eligible dependent education expenses after per-person caps in KRW

pensionSavings.description: Pension savings account contributions (연금저축) in KRW

irp.description: IRP / DC personal contributions in KRW

isaTransfer.description: Matured ISA amount moved to a pension account this year in KRW

rent.description: Monthly rent paid for the year in KRW

rentEligible.description: User confirmed the statutory rent credit requirements (homeless household head etc.)

marriage.description: Marriage registered 2024-2026 and the one-time marriage credit not yet used

youthSme.description: Eligible for the SME youth employment income tax reduction

withheld.description: Income tax withheld during the year (excluding local tax) in KRW; enables refund calculation

tools.name: calculate_kr_freelancer_income_tax
tools.description: South Korea freelancer (3.3% withholding, 사업소득) May comprehensive income tax estimate: simple expense rate 940909 (64.1%, 49.7% above 40M KRW) or a given expense ratio, compared with the tax already withheld to show refund or extra payment. Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Tax years 2025 and 2026 only; refuses unknown inputs.

revenue.description: Annual gross freelance revenue before 3.3% withholding in KRW

expenseRate.description: Expense ratio between 0 and 1 (e.g. 0.3). Omit to use the 940909 simple expense rate

pensionPremium.description: National pension contributions paid in KRW

tools.name: calculate_kr_acquisition_tax
tools.description: South Korea 2026 housing acquisition tax (주택 취득세) with local education tax and rural special tax: 1-3% standard rate (6-900M KRW sliding formula) or 8%/12% multi-home surcharge. Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Returns statute basis; does not judge house counts or first-home relief.

houses.description: Household houses including this one (4 = four or more), default 1

regulated.description: The house is in an adjustment target area (조정대상지역)

temporaryTwo.description: Temporary two-home case: the previous home will be sold within the deadline

over85.description: Exclusive area over 85 square meters (rural special tax applies)

tools.name: calculate_kr_property_tax
tools.description: South Korea 2026 housing property tax (주택 재산세) from the official price: fair market value ratio (43-45% for one-home households, 60% otherwise), one-home special rate up to 900M KRW, urban area tax and local education tax. Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Excludes comprehensive real estate holding tax and the burden cap.

oneHouse.description: One house per household (1세대1주택), default true

urbanArea.description: Inside an urban planning area (도시지역분 0.14%), default true

tools.name: value_kr_unlisted_shares
tools.description: South Korea unlisted share valuation for inheritance/gift tax (상증법 보충적 평가): 3-year weighted (3:2:1) net income value at 10% capitalization and net asset value, blended 3:2 (2:3 when real estate ≥ 50% of assets, net asset value only at ≥ 80% or 시행령 제54조 ④ cases), floored at 80% of net asset value, plus the 20% largest-shareholder premium unless exempt (SMEs, mid-sized firms under 500B KRW revenue). Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Inputs are the user's figures; returns statute basis and what is not covered.

netIncome1.description: Net income (순손익액) of the latest fiscal year before the valuation date, whole company, KRW; may be negative

netIncome2.description: Net income two years before, KRW

netIncome3.description: Net income three years before, KRW

netAssets.description: Net asset value at the valuation date under 상증법 market values (assets − liabilities), KRW

goodwill.description: Goodwill value to add (시행령 제59조 ②), KRW; default 0

realEstateRatio.description: Real estate and real-estate rights share of total assets, 0-1

netAssetOnlyReason.description: A 시행령 제54조 ④ case applies (under 3 years of business, closure/liquidation, shares ≥ 80% of assets, etc.)

heldShares.description: Shares being valued (held by the person)

isMajorityHolder.description: The holder is a largest shareholder (최대주주 등)

premiumExempt.description: Premium exemption applies (SME, mid-sized firm under 500B KRW 3-year average revenue, 3 straight loss years, etc.). Default true

tools.name: calculate_kr_family_business_deduction
tools.description: South Korea family business inheritance deduction (가업상속공제, 상증법 제18조의2) and inheritance tax with vs without it: cap 30B/40B/60B KRW for 10/20/30+ years of operation, qualifying value = share value × (1 − non-business asset ratio), plus lump-sum 500M, spouse and financial asset deductions and the 3% filing credit. Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Does not judge eligibility requirements or post-management; the 2026-08 reform proposal is not applied.

businessValue.description: Value of the family business shares (or sole-proprietor business assets), KRW

unrelatedAssetRatio.description: Non-business assets ÷ total assets of the company, 0-1 (0 for a sole proprietorship)

years.description: Years the deceased operated the business

size.description: sme, midsize (3-year average revenue under 500B KRW) or ineligible

otherEstate.description: Other inherited property outside the business, KRW

netFinancial.description: Net financial assets among the other property, KRW

spouseInherited.description: Amount the spouse actually inherits, KRW

tools.name: calculate_kr_incorporation_conversion
tools.description: South Korea sole proprietor to corporation conversion (개인사업자 법인전환): minimum capital (net asset value at market), capital gains tax deferred by 조특법 제32조 이월과세 on business real estate, and the 50% acquisition tax relief (지특법 제57조의2 ④, through 2027-12-31, not for real estate rental) net of the 20% rural special tax. Same formulas as tools.oiyo.net. Houses are excluded from the deferral.

business.description: Business type; consumption services (lodging, bars) get no deferral or relief

realEstateMarket.description: Market value of business real estate (not houses), KRW

realEstateCost.description: Acquisition cost plus necessary expenses of that real estate, KRW

otherAssets.description: Other business assets at market value, KRW

acquisitionBase.description: Acquisition tax base if different from market value, KRW; 0 uses market value

tools.name: calculate_dcf_valuation
tools.description: Discounted cash flow (DCF) enterprise and equity valuation: 3-10 year FCFF forecast with growth fading to the terminal rate, Gordon terminal value, optional mid-year convention, WACC given directly or built with CAPM, plus a WACC × terminal growth sensitivity table. Ratios are decimals (0.1 = 10%). Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

taxRate.description: Effective tax rate incl. local tax, default 0.22

nwcRatio.description: Net working capital increase ÷ revenue increase

wacc.description: WACC; omit to build it from the CAPM inputs

netDebt.description: Net debt (debt − cash); negative for net cash

tools.name: evaluate_decision_tree
tools.description: Decision tree expected value with rollback: give simple options (success probability, payoff if success / fail, upfront cost) or a full tree of decision / chance / outcome nodes. Returns the best path, expected value, outcome distribution, worst/best case, probability of loss, and for options the success probability at which the best choice would flip. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

question.description: The decision being made, e.g. '신규 매장을 열까?'

ifSuccess.description: Payoff if it succeeds (any currency, before cost)

cost.description: Upfront cost of choosing it, subtracted from both payoffs

options.description: 2-8 simple options. Give options or tree, not both.

tree.description: Full tree instead of options. Node: {label, kind: 'decision'|'chance'|'outcome', value (outcome only), branches: [{label, prob (chance branches, 0..1), cost, node}]}. Max 12 levels and 200 nodes.

tools.name: schedule_critical_path
tools.description: Project schedule by critical path method (CPM) with PERT three-point estimates: earliest/latest start and finish, slack and critical tasks, project duration, standard deviation and the probability of finishing by a deadline. Optional start date converts days to calendar dates (weekends skipped when workdaysOnly). Refuses unknown dependency ids and cycles. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

duration.description: Most likely duration in days (0 = milestone)

deps.description: Ids of tasks that must finish first

deadline.description: Deadline in days from the start, for the on-time probability

workdaysOnly.description: Count only Monday-Friday when converting to dates

tools.name: analyze_swot
tools.description: SWOT analysis with TOWS strategy pairs and the internal/external factor evaluation (IFE/EFE) and IE matrix: impact 1-5 decides the stance (SO attack, ST diversify, WO turnaround, WT defend); weight and rating 1-4 give IFE/EFE totals (2.5 is average) and the grow / hold / harvest cell. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

kind.description: S strength, W weakness, O opportunity, T threat

weight.description: IFE/EFE weight, 0..1 (normalised within S+W and O+T)

tools.name: classify_bcg_portfolio
tools.description: BCG growth-share matrix: classifies each business unit as star, cash cow, question mark or dog from market growth and relative market share (our share ÷ largest rival's share; if we lead, ÷ the runner-up), with revenue mix by quadrant, the recommended move and portfolio warnings. Ratios are decimals. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

rivalShare.description: Largest competitor's share (runner-up's if we lead), 0..1

tools.name: map_brand_positioning
tools.description: Marketing positioning map on two axes (-10..10 each): nearest competitor and distance for every brand, brands crowded together, and the largest empty spot on the map (optionally pulled toward a customer ideal point). Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

tools.name: calculate_unit_economics_runway
tools.description: Startup and small business economics in one call; give any complete group. Unit economics (arpu, grossMargin, monthlyChurn, cac): LTV, LTV/CAC grade, CAC payback months. Runway (cash, revenue, expenses, monthly growth rates): month-by-month cash, the month cash runs out, break-even month and whether the company is default alive. Break-even (fixedCost, price, variableCost): units and revenue. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

discountRate.description: Annual discount rate for LTV, default 0

expenses.description: Monthly expenses now, including cost of sales

fixedCost.description: Fixed cost for the break-even period

tools.name: rank_priorities
tools.description: Prioritise work or choose between options. method 'rice': Reach × Impact × Confidence ÷ Effort ranking. method 'weighted': weighted decision matrix (scores per criterion, weights normalised) with the weight each criterion would need to flip first and second place. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

reach.description: People or events affected in the period

impact.description: Impact: 0.25 tiny, 0.5 low, 1 medium, 2 high, 3 massive

scores.description: One score per criterion, same order (e.g. 1-5)

tools.name: get_kr_business_tax_calendar
tools.description: South Korea business filing calendar for one year (부가세·법인세·종합소득세·원천세·지급명세서·고용산재 보수총액): statutory date and the actual due date moved past weekends and public holidays (국세기본법 제5조), with the statute for each. Optional stage or role adds the must-do / must-not-do checklist for founders, management teams, bookkeepers and tax advisers. December fiscal year-end; estimate, not tax advice.

halfYearWithholding.description: Approved for half-yearly withholding tax filing

from.description: Also list the next 5 deadlines on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

stage.description: Add the checklist for this stage

role.description: Add the checklist for this role

tools.name: plan_kr_small_business_month
tools.description: One-page monthly back-office list for a Korean sole proprietor or small company: this month's filing deadlines (withholding tax, VAT, payment statements, income or corporate tax), 4 social insurance premiums (10th), monthly-total tax invoices (10th, 부가가치세법 제34조③), wage statements on payday (근로기준법 제48조②), and event deadlines for hires (written contract, insurance enrolment by the 15th of the next month) and leavers (settle wages and severance within 14 days, insurance loss report). Due dates move past weekends and public holidays; overdue items and deadlines that fall next month are separated; adds routine monthly bookkeeping. December fiscal year-end; no filing or drafting.

halfYearWithholding.description: Approved for half-yearly withholding tax filing

hires.description: Hire dates this or last month, YYYY-MM-DD

leaves.description: Leaving dates this or last month, YYYY-MM-DD

today.description: Reference date for days left and overdue (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: plan_campaign_supply
tools.description: Campaign demand vs supply: from weekly demand, opening stock, weekly production capacity and the lead time for extra production, returns the first stockout week, total shortage, fill rate, the uniform extra production per week needed from the first week extra output can arrive, and the shortage that extra production cannot fix in time. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

openingStock.description: Stock on hand at the start

capacityPerWeek.description: Units produced or received per week

safetyStock.description: Stock to keep at all times, default 0

tools.name: evaluate_influencer_deal
tools.description: Influencer (creator) contract check: expected clicks, orders, revenue, ROAS, contribution after gross margin and fees, CPM, CPA, break-even orders and conversion, plus South Korea withholding on the payment (3.3% business income, 8.8% other income) or 10% VAT for a business payee, and the disclosure/contract checklist with statutes. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

tools.name: plan_quality_recovery
tools.description: Quality incident recovery: defects and units in market per lot, cost of three recall scopes (defects only, all shipped units of the lots, whole lots including warehouse), and how to allocate the remaining good stock among customers (priority first, highest penalty first, pro rata) with the shortfall penalty of each rule. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

penaltyPerUnit.description: Penalty or loss per unit not delivered

tools.name: compare_alternative_materials
tools.description: Alternative raw material review: annual saving vs the current price, months to recover test/certification cost, weeks to approval (test plus filing when labels or functional claims change), and a weighted 1-5 score on cost, quality, supply stability and speed, with warnings. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

needsFiling.description: Label/ingredient list or functional claim filing needed

filingWeeks.description: Weeks added when filing is needed, default 8

tools.name: check_big_order_capacity
tools.description: Big new order vs existing commitments under limited capacity: profit of declining, accepting in full, accepting only spare capacity, accepting with overtime/outsourcing, and the profit-maximising quantity; existing orders are cut in order of lowest margin plus penalty and locked commitments are never cut in the recommendation. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

capacity.description: Units that can be made in the period

penaltyPerUnit.description: Penalty or relationship loss per unit short

tools.name: analyze_market_test
tools.description: Overseas market test: sample size per group to detect a relative lift (two-sided, alpha 0.05), two-proportion z-test of A/B results with p-value and 95% CI, and full-entry economics (monthly profit, payback of entry cost, break-even conversion, go / extend / stop). Give any of the three parts. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

baseline.description: Current conversion rate for sample size

costRatio.description: Cost ratio incl. logistics, duty, fees, 0..1

scaleFactor.description: Full-entry traffic as a multiple of the test

tools.name: check_sales_rebates
tools.description: Sales rebate (판매장려금) check: rebate due per partner from contract tiers, optional aggregation of related partners in a group, overpayment (hold) and underpayment (review) against requests, related-party rates above the unrelated range (부당행위계산 부인 risk), group splits that would change the tier, and Korean VAT/corporate tax notes with statutes. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

aggregateGroups.description: Contract allows group sales to be combined for the tier

armsLengthCheck.description: Compare related-party rates with the unrelated range

tools.name: evaluate_acquisition
tools.description: Acquisition screen: new shares and after-tax interest from the stock/debt mix, EPS accretion or dilution by year as synergies ramp up, payback year of price plus after-tax integration cost, implied vs own P/E, the synergy needed to keep year-1 EPS, and a default 100-day integration (PMI) schedule. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

stockPortion.description: Share of price paid in stock, rest debt, 0..1

synergy.description: Annual pre-tax synergy when fully realised

tools.name: calculate_kr_work_child_incentive
tools.description: Korean earned income tax credit (근로장려금) and child tax credit (자녀장려금) estimate for the 2026 application (2025 income): household type, combined total income, household assets (debts not deducted) and children under 18. Applies phase-in / maximum / phase-out bands, 50% cut at assets ≥ 170M KRW, nothing at ≥ 240M KRW, 95% for late filing. Returns both amounts, the band and how to apply.

household.description: single = no spouse or dependants; oneEarner = spouse earns under 3M KRW or supports a child/parent; twoEarner = spouse earns 3M KRW or more

income.description: Combined household total income for the year (wages gross, business revenue × industry ratio) (KRW)

assets.description: Total assets of all household members on June 1 (housing, deposits incl. jeonse, savings, cars; debts not deducted) (KRW)

tools.name: calculate_kr_maternity_leave_pay
tools.description: Korean maternity leave pay (출산전후휴가 급여) and spouse childbirth leave (배우자 출산휴가 20일) for 2026: monthly ordinary wage, priority-support (SME) employer or not, single / multiple / premature birth. Splits employer and employment-insurance shares with the 2026 caps (2.2M KRW per 30 days; 20-day spouse cap 1,684,210 KRW) and the minimum-wage floor.

priorityFirm.description: Priority-support employer (most SMEs): insurance pays all leave days

kind.description: single 90 days, multiple 120 days, premature 100 days

tools.name: calculate_kr_wage_guarantee
tools.description: Korean wage guarantee payment (대지급금) the state pays first for unpaid wages and severance: simple payment for retired workers (wages 7M + severance 7M, total 10M KRW), simple payment for current low-income workers (7M), or insolvency payment with age-based monthly caps (220/310/350/330/230만원) covering the last 6 months of wages when the insolvency decision is on or after 2026-08-20 (3 months before) and the last 3 years of severance.

kind.description: simpleRetired = retired, employer still exists; simpleEmployed = still employed; insolvency = rehabilitation, bankruptcy or recognised insolvency

age.description: Age at retirement (or application if employed)

unpaidMonths.description: Number of final months not paid

serviceYears.description: Years of service behind the severance

afterReform.description: Insolvency decision on or after 2026-08-20 (default true)

tools.name: calculate_kr_injury_leave_pay
tools.description: Korean industrial accident leave pay (산재 휴업급여) for 2026: 70% of average daily wage, the low-income minimum-wage guarantee (82,560 KRW a day), the maximum compensation base 268,299 KRW, nothing when treatment is 3 days or less. Give avgDailyWage, or threeMonthWages with calendarDays.

threeMonthWages.description: Wages in the 3 months before the accident (instead of avgDailyWage) (KRW)

annualBonus.description: Bonuses paid in the last year (3/12 added) (KRW)

tools.name: calculate_kr_monthly_rent_credit
tools.description: Korean monthly rent tax credit (월세 세액공제, 조세특례제한법 제95조의2): 17% when total salary ≤ 55M KRW (comprehensive income ≤ 45M), 15% up to 80M (70M), rent up to 10M KRW a year, plus the 10% local income tax reduction. Optional tax before credit caps the credit.

income.description: Total salary (wage earners) or comprehensive income amount (KRW)

months.description: Months of rent paid this year

taxBeforeCredit.description: Income tax left before this credit (optional cap) (KRW)

tools.name: compare_kr_retirement_pension
tools.description: Korean retirement pension DB vs DC comparison (퇴직연금 DB형 vs DC형): DB = final monthly wage × total years; DC = past DB accrual moved now plus one month's wage each year compounded at the return. Returns both amounts, the gap, year-by-year series and the break-even return.

dcReturn.description: Annual DC return after fees, e.g. 0.04

tools.name: calculate_kr_ordinary_wage
tools.description: Korean ordinary wage (통상임금) hourly rate and statutory overtime / night / holiday premiums, before and after the Supreme Court en banc ruling of 2024-12-19 (2020다247190) that counts regular bonuses with an employment-on-payday condition. Monthly ordinary wage = base + fixed allowances + annual regular bonus ÷ 12, divided by contracted monthly hours (209 for 40 h/week). Overtime ×1.5, night +0.5, holiday ×1.5 up to 8 h and ×2 beyond; firms under 5 employees pay no premium.

fixedAllowances.description: Monthly allowances paid to everyone at a fixed amount (KRW)

bonusConditional.description: Bonus paid only to those employed on the payday (or after a minimum number of days)

holidayOver8.description: Holiday hours beyond 8 a day (part of holiday)

tools.name: check_kr_fixed_overtime_pay
tools.description: Check a Korean fixed overtime allowance (포괄임금 고정 연장수당) against the statutory premium for the hours actually worked. Hourly = pay excluding the fixed allowance ÷ monthly hours; shortfall per month × up to 36 months (3-year wage claim limitation). Also flags pay below the 2026 minimum wage (10,320 KRW/h) and how many overtime hours the fixed allowance covers.

basePay.description: Monthly base pay and fixed allowances, excluding the fixed overtime allowance (KRW)

fixedOtPay.description: Fixed overtime / night / holiday allowance in the monthly pay (KRW)

tools.name: calculate_kr_comprehensive_real_estate_tax
tools.description: Korean comprehensive real estate holding tax on housing (종합부동산세 주택분) for 2026: deduction 1.2B KRW for a one-house household (900M otherwise, 0 for corporations), fair market ratio 60%, rates 0.5-2.7% (3+ houses: 2-5% above a 1.2B base; corporations 2.7%/5%), property-tax overlap credit, one-house age (20/30/40%) and holding (20/40/50%) credits up to 80%, rural special tax 20%. Excludes the 150% year-on-year cap.

items.description: Official price (공시가격) of one house on June 1 (KRW)

tools.name: calculate_kr_housing_rental_income_tax
tools.description: Korean housing rental income tax (주택임대소득세): one house exempt unless standard price > 1.2B KRW, deemed rent on deposits for 3+ houses ((deposits − 300M) × 60% × 3.1%), separate taxation at 14% when revenue ≤ 20M (expense 60% registered / 50% not, basic deduction 4M / 2M when other income ≤ 20M) compared with comprehensive taxation; both include local income tax.

houses.description: Houses owned by the couple (small houses excluded)

highPriceOneHouse.description: With one house: its standard price is above 1.2B KRW

annualRent.description: Monthly rent received over the year (KRW)

registered.description: Registered as a rental business with both the local government and the tax office

otherIncome.description: Other comprehensive income amount (wage income amount etc.) (KRW)

interestRate.description: Deposit interest rate for deemed rent (default 0.031)

actualExpenseRate.description: Actual expense ratio for comprehensive taxation (books)

otherTaxBase.description: Tax base of other income (default otherIncome × 0.7) (KRW)

tools.name: calculate_kr_long_term_care_copay
tools.description: Korean long-term care insurance copay (노인장기요양 본인부담금) for 2026: home care (재가) monthly limits by grade (1: 2,512,900 … 5: 1,208,900; cognitive 676,320 KRW) at 15%, facility care (시설) daily rates (1: 93,070, 2: 86,340, 3-5: 81,540 KRW) at 20%, 40%/60% reductions, basic livelihood recipients exempt; home use above the limit and facility meals are paid in full.

reduction.description: Copay reduction: 40%, 60%, or basic livelihood recipient (0)

homeUse.description: Home care used per month at official fees (default: the grade limit) (KRW)

dailyExtra.description: Facility non-covered cost per day such as meals (default 15,000) (KRW)

tools.name: check_kr_dependent_deduction
tools.description: Korean year-end dependent deduction check (부양가족 기본공제) for 2026: for each family member judges age (parents 60+, children 20 or under, siblings ≤20 or 60+, foster children under 18; disabled or basic-livelihood recipients any age), income (wage-only total pay ≤ 5M KRW, otherwise income amount ≤ 1M KRW), living together (siblings, grandchildren, foster children) and double claims; adds 70+ (1M) and disabled (2M) extra deductions and counts child tax credit children (ages 9-20, born 2017 excluded). Compares year-end tax with and without the family using the same settlement formula (other deductions assumed zero, social insurance estimated) and gives the tax each person saves.

salary.description: Claimant's total pay for the year (non-taxable excluded) (KRW)

married.description: Claimant has a spouse (used for single-parent and woman-head extra deductions)

selfFemale.description: Claimant is a woman (woman-head deduction 500,000 KRW when earned income amount ≤ 30M)

relation.description: parent includes grandparents and the spouse's parents; child includes adopted children

wage.description: Total pay from employment for the year (KRW)

otherIncome.description: Other comprehensive income amount (business, pension, other, capital gains, retirement); separately taxed interest/dividends excluded (KRW)

livingTogether.description: Registered at the same address (needed for siblings, grandchildren and foster children)

basicLivelihood.description: Basic livelihood security recipient (no age limit)

claimedByOther.description: Another taxpayer already claims this person

tools.name: calculate_kr_stock_major_shareholder_tax
tools.description: Korean listed stock capital gains tax for major shareholders (상장주식 대주주 양도세) in 2026: major shareholder if, at the end of the previous business year, the holding in one stock was worth 5B KRW or more, or the stake was at least 1% (KOSPI) / 2% (KOSDAQ) / 4% (KONEX); the September 2025 plan to lower the line to 1B KRW was withdrawn. Tax = (gain − 2.5M basic deduction) × 20% up to a 300M tax base and 25% above (30% for non-SME shares held under one year) + 10% local income tax. Non-major individuals selling on the exchange owe none. Securities transaction tax not included.

heldValue.description: Market value of the stock held at the end of the previous business year (largest shareholder: include related parties) (KRW)

gain.description: Capital gain from this year's sales of the stock (sale − cost − fees) (KRW)

overOneYear.description: Held for one year or more

deductionUsed.description: The 2.5M KRW basic deduction was already used on other share sales this year

tools.name: calculate_kr_dismissal_notice_pay
tools.description: Korean dismissal notice pay (해고예고수당, 근로기준법 제26조): without 30 days' notice the employer owes 30 days of ordinary wage (the Ministry of Employment and Labor treats any shorter notice as owing the full 30 days). Exceptions: under 3 months of service, natural disaster making the business impossible, intentional serious damage listed in the enforcement rule. Applies to workplaces of any size; written notice (제27조) and unfair-dismissal remedy within 3 months (제28조) only for 5+ employees. Daily ordinary wage = monthly ordinary wage ÷ monthly paid hours (40 h/week = 209) × daily hours.

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage (기본급 + fixed monthly allowances) (KRW)

noticeDays.description: Days of notice before the dismissal date (0 = same day)

exception.description: 제26조 exception claimed by the employer

fivePlus.description: Workplace normally employs 5 or more people

tools.name: calculate_kr_shutdown_allowance
tools.description: Korean shutdown allowance (휴업수당, 근로기준법 제46조 · 시행령 제26조) when the employer suspends work for its own reasons: at least 70% of average wage for the shutdown days; the ordinary wage may be paid instead when 70% of average wage exceeds it; wages paid for partial work during the period are deducted first; less is allowed only with Labor Relations Commission approval; not applicable under 5 employees (시행령 별표 1). Average daily wage = 3-month wages ÷ calendar days.

threeMonthWages.description: Total wages for the 3 months before the shutdown (KRW)

paidDuringShutdown.description: Wages received for partial work during the shutdown (KRW)

approvedReduction.description: The Labor Relations Commission approved a lower allowance

fivePlus.description: Workplace normally employs 5 or more people

tools.name: calculate_kr_reduced_hours_childcare_pay
tools.description: Korean reduced working hours for childcare benefit (육아기 근로시간 단축 급여) for 2026: child aged 12 or under (grade 6 or lower), hours after reduction 15-35 per week. First 10 weekly hours cut: monthly ordinary wage (base capped 2.5M, floor 0.5M KRW) × cut ÷ hours before; hours beyond 10: 80% of ordinary wage (cap 1.6M, floor 0.5M) × cut ÷ hours before (고용보험법 시행령 제104조의2). Returns the insurance benefit, the employer's reduced pay, the monthly total and the remaining loss.

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage on the start date (KRW)

afterHours.description: Weekly contracted hours after the reduction (15-35)

tools.name: check_kr_probation_minimum_wage
tools.description: Korean probation minimum wage check (수습 최저임금) for 2026: 90% of the minimum wage (9,288 KRW/hour instead of 10,320) only for a contract of one year or more (or open-ended), within 3 months from the start of probation, and not in simple manual jobs (최저임금법 제5조②, 시행령 제3조). Returns the applicable minimum and the hourly and monthly shortfall (209 hours).

contractMonths.description: Contract length in months (0 = no fixed term)

monthsIntoProbation.description: Months since probation started (0 in the first month)

simpleLabor.description: Simple manual job (cleaning, security, delivery, kitchen help, shelving etc.)

tools.name: plan_kr_annual_leave_promotion
tools.description: Korean annual leave use promotion schedule (연차 사용촉진, 근로기준법 제61조): annual leave (①) = written prompt within 10 days from 6 months before the period ends, worker replies within 10 days, employer designates dates in writing by 2 months before; first-year monthly leave (②) = prompt within 10 days from 3 months before (leave arising later: 5 days from 1 month before), designation by 1 month before (later leave: 10 days before). Only when every step is done in writing on time does the employer owe no pay for unused leave. Not applicable under 5 employees.

kind.description: annual = leave of workers with 1+ year; firstYear = monthly leave in the first year

periodEnd.description: Last day the leave can be used (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. 2027-12-31 for a fiscal-year system

tools.name: check_kr_voluntary_quit_unemployment
tools.description: Korean unemployment benefit after voluntary resignation: checks the justified reasons in 고용보험법 시행규칙 별표 2 (amended 2024-07-01). Item 1 (worse conditions, unpaid wages, below minimum wage, overtime limit violations, shutdown pay under 70%) counts only if it lasted 2+ months within the year before leaving; commuting needs 3+ hours round trip; family care needs 30+ days and refused leave; health and pregnancy/childcare need refused leave or transfer. Also checks 180 insured days in the 18 months before leaving (제40조). Returns per-reason results with evidence to bring; the employment center decides.

months.description: Months within the year before leaving that an item-1 reason lasted

commuteHours.description: Round-trip commute hours after the change, by ordinary transport

leaveRefused.description: The employer refused leave, a leave of absence or a job transfer

insuredDays.description: Insured (paid) days in the 18 months before leaving

tools.name: check_kr_subcontract_direct_payment
tools.description: Korean subcontract direct payment (하도급대금 직접 지급, 하도급법 제14조): the client (발주자) must pay the subcontractor directly when the prime contractor stops payment, goes bankrupt or loses its license (on request), the three parties agree, the prime missed 2+ installments (on request), or the prime gave no payment guarantee (on request); blocked when the prime documents the subcontractor's own wage or material arrears (③); limited to what the client has not yet paid the prime (④). Also late interest at 15.5% a year after 60 days from delivery (제13조⑧, FTC notice).

missedInstallments.description: Installments the prime has not paid

requested.description: The subcontractor asked the client for direct payment

primeStopRequest.description: The prime documented the subcontractor's wage/material arrears and asked the client to stop

workValue.description: Subcontract price of the work done (KRW)

receivedFromPrime.description: Amount already received from the prime (KRW)

ownerUnpaidToPrime.description: Amount the client still owes the prime for that work (KRW)

daysSinceDelivery.description: Days since delivery or completion was accepted

tools.name: check_kr_family_loan_interest
tools.description: Korean gift tax on a low- or zero-interest family loan (상증법 제41조의4): the benefit is interest at the statutory 4.6% (시행규칙 제10조의5) minus interest actually agreed; it is a gift only when the benefit reaches 10M KRW a year (then the whole benefit, recomputed every year). Returns the benefit, gift tax after the remaining 증여재산공제 and 3% filing credit, the largest interest-free principal (about 217.39M), the lowest safe rate for this principal and the lender's 27.5% withholding on interest received. The principal itself must be a real loan with repayment records.

rate.description: Agreed annual interest rate as a decimal (0.02 = 2%)

deductionLeft.description: Borrower's unused gift deduction over 10 years (adult child 50M, minor 20M, spouse 600M) (KRW)

tools.name: check_kr_parent_house_free_use
tools.description: Korean gift tax on living rent-free in a family member's property (상증법 제37조①): benefit = property value × 2% a year, summed over 5 years discounted at 10% (factor ≈ 3.7908); a gift only when it reaches 100M KRW (property ≈ 1.319B KRW) and not when living together with the owner. Also free use as loan collateral (제37조②): loan × 4.6% − interest paid, a gift from 10M KRW a year. Returns both benefits and gift tax.

propertyValue.description: Market value of the property (or standard value if none) (KRW)

coResiding.description: The user lives together with the owner in that home

collateralLoan.description: Loan borrowed using the property as free collateral (KRW)

collateralInterest.description: Interest actually paid on that loan per year (KRW)

tools.name: check_kr_family_low_price_sale
tools.description: Korean below-market sale between related parties: buyer gift (상증법 제35조①) when market value − price ≥ min(30% of market value, 300M KRW), gift value = the difference minus that threshold; seller capital gains recomputed at market value (소득세법 제101조, 시행령 제167조③) when the difference ≥ min(5%, 300M KRW). Returns both tests, gift tax and the lowest prices that avoid each.

deductionLeft.description: Buyer's unused gift deduction over 10 years (KRW)

tools.name: check_kr_commercial_rent_increase
tools.description: Korean commercial lease rent increase cap (상가건물 임대차보호법): converted deposit = deposit + monthly rent × 100; if within the regional limit (Seoul 900M, other overcrowding zones and Busan 690M, metropolitan cities etc. 540M, elsewhere 370M KRW) increases are capped at 5% of rent or deposit (시행령 제4조) and allowed once a year (제11조②); converting deposit to rent is capped at min(12%, base rate × 4.5) (시행령 제5조). Above the limit, renewal rights (10 years), opposability and key-money protection still apply (제10조의2).

region.description: seoul; overcrowded = 과밀억제권역 outside Seoul and Busan; metro = metropolitan cities, Sejong, Paju, Hwaseong, Ansan, Yongin, Gimpo, Gwangju (Gyeonggi); other

newMonthlyRent.description: Monthly rent the landlord asks for (KRW)

monthsSinceLast.description: Months since the contract or the last increase

baseRate.description: Bank of Korea base rate as a decimal (default 0.03)

tools.name: calculate_kr_sme_youth_tax_reduction
tools.description: Korean income tax reduction for young employees of SMEs (조특법 제30조): 15-34 at contract (military service up to 6 years subtracted), 90% of earned-income tax, capped at 2M KRW per year, for the months through 5 years after starting. Computes year-end tax with and without the reduction (social insurance estimated from salary), the end month and a 5-year estimate. The 2026 tax reform proposal to lengthen the period outside the capital region from 2027 is not applied.

tools.name: calculate_kr_yellow_umbrella_deduction
tools.description: Korean 노란우산공제 (small business mutual aid) income deduction (조특법 제86조의3): payments deducted from business income up to 6M (income ≤ 40M KRW), 5M (≤ 60M), 4M (≤ 100M) or 2M (above); small-company CEOs only with salary ≤ 80M, against earned income. Returns the limit, deduction and tax saved including local tax at progressive rates. Annual payment cap 18M from July 2026.

kind.description: business = sole proprietor; ceo = small-company representative

income.description: Business income (revenue − expenses, excluding real-estate rental); for ceo the total salary (KRW)

otherDeductions.description: Other income deductions such as personal deductions (default 1.5M) (KRW)

tools.name: compare_kr_general_vs_simplified_vat
tools.description: Korean VAT: general vs simplified taxpayer (부가가치세법). Simplified allowed under 104M KRW annual sales including VAT (48M for real-estate rental etc.), pays sales × sector value-added rate (15-40%) × 10% − 0.5% of purchases, no refunds, exempt under 48M; general pays output − input VAT and can get refunds. Both get the 1.3% card-sales credit (cap 10M). Returns both taxes, which is cheaper, eligibility and the tax invoice duty.

sector.description: retail = retail and restaurants 15%; manufacturing 20%; lodging 25%; construction = construction, transport, ICT 30%; service = other services 30%; professional = professional services, finance, real estate 40%

purchases.description: Annual purchases with tax invoices or cards, including VAT (KRW)

cardShare.description: Share of sales paid by card or cash receipt (0-1)

tools.name: calculate_kr_business_car_expense
tools.description: Korean business passenger car expense limits (법인세법 제27조의2, 소득세법 제33조의2): without a logbook only 15M KRW of annual car costs count as business use; business-use depreciation (5-year straight line; lease = lease fee net of insurance/tax/repairs; long-term rent = 70% of rent) above 8M a year is carried over. Returns total, business ratio, deductible, disallowed, carry-over, tax saved and the amount deductible with a full logbook. Requires business-only car insurance; special corporations (500M/400M rules) not covered.

ownership.description: own = purchased; lease; rent = long-term rental

amount.description: own: purchase price incl. VAT; lease: annual lease fee net of included insurance/tax/repairs; rent: annual rent (KRW)

otherCosts.description: Annual fuel, insurance, car tax, repairs, tolls (KRW)

businessShare.description: Business share of distance from the logbook (0-1)

marginalRate.description: Marginal tax rate including local tax (0-1, default 0.264)

tools.name: compare_kr_overseas_stock_vs_etf_tax
tools.description: Korean tax on the same gain via overseas stocks held directly (capital gains: 2.5M deduction then 22%, separate), a domestically listed overseas ETF (dividend income 15.4% withheld; above 20M of interest and dividends the excess is taxed at the marginal rate) or such an ETF inside an ISA (2M / 4M tax-free, then 9.9%). Returns the three taxes, the cheapest and the break-even gain (~8.33M).

otherFinancial.description: Other interest and dividend income this year (KRW)

marginalRate.description: Marginal rate for comprehensive taxation including local tax (0-1, default 0.264)

tools.name: check_kr_officetel_house_count
tools.description: Korean officetel (오피스텔) house-count check by tax: acquisition tax counts officetels acquired from 2020-08-12 whose property tax is levied as housing (지방세법 시행령 제28조의4); capital-gains surcharge and comprehensive real estate tax count residential use in fact (소득세법 제88조); the 2024-01-10 small new-build rule (60㎡ or less, price 600M metro / 300M elsewhere, built and first sold 2024-01-10 to 2027-12-31) removes it from acquisition, surcharge and 종부세 counts but not from the one-house exemption test; housing subscription never counts officetels. Returns each test, the officetel's own 4.6% acquisition tax and the extra acquisition tax on the next home caused by the officetel.

residentialUse.description: Used as a home in fact (owner or tenant lives there)

propertyTaxAsHouse.description: Property tax is levied as housing (default = residentialUse)

firstSaleNew.description: New build (2024-01-10 to 2027-12-31) bought first from the developer

otherHouses.description: Houses the household owns besides the officetel

nextHomePrice.description: Price of the next home to buy (for acquisition tax comparison) (KRW)

nextRegulated.description: Next home is in a regulated area

tools.name: compare_kr_ticket_vs_presale_tax
tools.description: Korean capital gains tax on a redevelopment/reconstruction member right (조합원입주권) vs an apartment pre-sale right (분양권) (소득세법 제104조①): member rights are taxed like houses (under 1 year 70%, under 2 years 60%, then 6-45%), original members get the long-term holding deduction on the gain up to the management-disposal approval date and the one-house exemption up to 1.2B if the old house qualified on that date; pre-sale rights are 70% under 1 year then 60%, with no deduction or exemption. 2.5M basic deduction, +10% local tax. Returns the chosen right's tax plus both totals.

holdYears.description: Holding period in years (original members count from the old house's acquisition)

original.description: Original member who owned the old house

preApprovalGain.description: Gain up to the management-disposal approval date (original members) (KRW)

yearsToApproval.description: Years from old house acquisition to the approval date

oneHouseExempt.description: Met the one-house exemption on the approval date with no other house

liveYears.description: Years lived in the old house (one-house deduction table 2)

tools.name: compare_kr_inherited_house_valuation
tools.description: Inherited house: declare at the official price (기준시가) or an appraisal (감정평가)? The declared value becomes the acquisition cost when the heir sells (소득세법 시행령 제163조⑨), so a low value cuts inheritance tax but raises later capital gains tax. Computes inheritance tax (lump-sum 500M, spouse 500M-3B, appraisal fee up to 5M deducted, 3% filing credit, 10-50%) plus capital gains tax on a later sale (heir has another house, no surcharge; long-term deduction from the inheritance date) for both values and returns the cheaper choice.

otherEstate.description: Other net estate (after debts and funeral costs) (KRW)

tools.name: plan_kr_inheritance_gift_filing_deadline
tools.description: Korean inheritance and gift tax filing deadlines (상증법 제67조·제68조): inheritance tax within 6 months (9 abroad) from the last day of the month of death, gift tax within 3 months from the last day of the month of the gift; also acquisition tax (지방세법 제20조), the deceased's income tax return, death report and renunciation deadlines, and the gift-return windows (제4조④). With tax and lateDays returns the 3% filing credit, no-filing penalty (20% with 50/30/20% relief for late filing within 1/3/6 months) and late-payment penalty (0.022% a day).

abroad.description: Deceased and all heirs live abroad (inheritance only)

lateDays.description: Days filed and paid after the deadline

tools.name: plan_kr_after_death_tasks
tools.description: What a Korean family must do after a death, with dated deadlines in order: death report (1 month from learning of the death, 가족관계등록법 제84조), 안심상속 one-stop asset and debt inquiry (1 year from the end of the month of death), renunciation or limited acceptance (3 months from learning, 민법 제1019조), unpaid wages and severance (employer pays within 14 days, 근로기준법 제36조), refusing a lease succession (1 month, 주택임대차보호법 제9조), closing a business VAT return (25 days after the month end), the deceased's income tax, inheritance acquisition tax, car transfer and inheritance tax (6 months from the month end, 9 abroad), life insurance and industrial-accident survivor claims (3 years) and National Pension survivor claims (5 years). Deadlines on holidays move to the next business day. Returns each task with where to go, what to bring, the statute and what happens if missed, plus overdue and next tasks for a given today.

tools.description: Open the OIYO practice office for a country and room: tax, labor (employment), admin (permits, renting, consumer, customs), legal (registry, court costs, limitation, family, inheritance) trade (customs, small-parcel import duty and VAT: open for KR, JP, UK, CA) or plan (saving, pensions, loans); the Korea floor also has insurance (claims, medical expense cover, car accidents), realty (brokerage, renting, buying, registration), biz (start-up, franchise) and welfare (benefits, medical costs, care). Returns the five intake questions that change the answer, the calculators and checkers (with their MCP tool names), the Claude skills and the free official help for that room. Leave out room to list the rooms with tool counts. Start here when you do not know which tool fits. General information only; no advice, representation or filing.
